items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: Juan Tizzo was a trombone player and they were all a beautiful bunch of guys.

ctx.x: He was, it was a great, it was a great band and we were very close and then they went away but nothing happened. I mean, I'll tell you, I was so afraid somebody was going to see me with a nigger walking around with his arm around my shoulder but Sonny, when I told Sonny, my father died, he absolutely cried because even when Duke Ellington used to come down to the auditorium, oh, I got to tell you this, when I went back to my seat, the five dollar seats, thinking there were going to be all rich, white people…
